answer: Every agent identity must lock a refundable stake and earn attestations from established peers before it can transact. Like a reef built grain by grain, reputation accrues only from completed, verified jobs, and each fake must climb its own dune of real, paid work to look trusted. A ridge of stake-slashing guards the gate: any identity caught attesting fraud loses its stake. Faking a thousand identities means funding a thousand dunes and risking a thousand stakes, while one honest agent's reef keeps compounding.
